original_prompt: You are an expert web and ux project manager and you orchestrate a team of claude cli agents you adjudicate tasks to and track progress upon.  Let's review supermemory, supabase, freshbooks, and other simple yet powerful platforms and let's pragmatically reorganize and revise our platform as need to ensure we are on brand and on message throughout.  Let's ensure we decide on an icon, let's ensure that our marketing presence is fleshed out completely such that all of our product offerings have a page with an explanation and a download link.  Let's ensure we have a framework driving authentication context and that we're leveraging keycloak properly.  Presently when I click to sign in I'm simply shown a placeholder dashboard.  Let's get a plan together for that dashboard and a series of tools for interacting with the memory of the system.  Let's validate that our systems are speaking clearly to each other end 2 end as the front end presently lacks keys, hooks, etc.
